name: Goretek CorpSec Field Loadout Mk-7
description: Head-to-toe CorpSec field kit: matte-black ballistic-rated helmet with integrated AR visor and neural port passthrough, gorget collar sealing against chem particulate. Torso runs a Goretek TacShell-derived hard-plate vest over a moisture-wicking compression underlayer with spinal-rig channel running center-back. Mid-layer is a dark charcoal ops jacket, mag-closure, with chrome-arm sleeve splits. Reinforced cargo trousers in graphite ripstop, knee-pad inserts, thigh holster mounts. Boots are steel-toe mag-lock tactical with ankle-brace integration for leg prosthetics. All hardware matte-finished to suppress EM signature.
functionality: Full ballistic protection to Class-3 threat rating; spinal-rig channel accommodates most standard military augments; chrome-arm sleeve splits; integrated AR visor with BCI uplink; mag-lock boot sole for vertical surface operations; chem-seal gorget.
what_it_says: This person is contracted, armed, and authorized — approach with stated business only.
story_hooks: A field kit with a serial number that traces back to a decommissioned unit — the wearer shouldn't exist in any active roster.
The AR visor keeps overlaying a ghost contact that was deleted from the network six months ago.
CorpSec insignia has been field-stripped and replaced with blank panels — someone's operating off-book.
